scientific_integrity: Derivations use exact stationary moment equations and derivative sign analysis; bundled algebraic and finite-time diagnostics are supporting checks, not independent certification. An equivalent prior derivation outside inspected literature is not excluded.
scientific_limitations: Scalar two-component quadratics, unit proximal step, iid uncorrected sampling; varying sampling changes the implicit objective, although the equally weighted benchmark is held fixed. No nonlinear, finite-time-optimal, or importance-corrected extension is proved.
title: A sharp sampling-collapse transition for constant-step stochastic proximal quadratics
